_meta.purpose: Accepted, intentional deviations from source-baseline.json. The visual-diff hook suppresses drift matching these entries so real regressions aren't lost in noise.
_meta.matching: Each entry names a block, a property path (dot notation), and why. The hook skips a drift when block+property matches an entry (value patterns optional).

allow.reason: Brand uses proprietary FreightSans (freightsans_pro*). No licensed webfont is committed; migrated stack is freightsans, freightsans-fallback, helvetica, arial. Family-name mismatch is expected everywhere.
Source H1 is FreightSans Prolight weight 200; the fallback stack renders the light heading token at weight 300. Cosmetic, font-substitution artifact.
Source applies -1.5px tracking tied to the proprietary font's metrics; not replicated on the fallback to avoid over-tightening a different typeface.
Line-height derives from the substituted font metrics; content and size match.
Migrated button uses the global button padding token (0.75em 1.6em) rather than the source's fixed 15px 27px. Same visual weight; keeps buttons consistent site-wide.
Source alternates two near-identical light greys (#ebeef2 / #f0f2f6); migration uses one --light-color (#f4f6f8) for all bands. Visually equivalent, intentionally simplified.

structural._note: Non-style intentional differences (documented for the pre-PR full critique, not the per-property hook):
items: Talk to Us form is an inline block placed as the last page section; source renders it as a modal triggered by TALK TO US.
Header nav and footer are rebuilt EDS chrome (nav/footer documents), not a DOM copy of the source.
Legal footer links are placeholders (# / no destination) pending real URLs from Broadridge.
Hero adds a navy scrim over the photo for text legibility (source relies on the image being dark).
